lesson.title: DDA Gallery · Lofts and cinema fragments
lesson.instructions: Orbit outside the proxy room to see its cutaway. The locked DDA scan is aligned and can be revealed in the outliner. Three lofted plates carry archival films. Split the Director and any Orb projector view to inspect its head and hand fragments. Turn on Live tracking under that projector’s Script tab to test MediaPipe against the running archival clip.
